notes: Counts of distinct public directory record IDs, not a new census of institutions or a count of campuses. Public directory contains responding institutions consenting to publication; totals may differ from survey totals. Preserve source 州・市 labels: these mix provinces, states, cities, regions and federal districts, not uniform administrative levels. Taiwan and Taiwan2 are merged by exact subdivision label, as JF instructs searching both. Blank locations remain unlocated; no address geocoding or boundary inference. Only aggregated geography is retained, no contacts or individual record text. Snapshot is separate from textbook evidence, country survey totals and clustering.
